req.title: Mark task complete
req.statement: The system shall set completed=true when a PUT payload includes {"completed": true}.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of marking a task as complete via the PUT /tasks/{task_id} endpoint. It includes tests for positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations such as operator flips, boundary errors, and incorrect status codes.

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_positive
preconditions: A task exists in the database with id=1
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with payload {'completed': true}
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task
response = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Test Task', 'description': 'Test Description'})
assert response.status_code == 201
created_task = response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Action: Mark task as complete
response = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'completed': True})

# Expected: Check response
assert response.status_code == 200
updated_task = response.json()
assert updated_task['completed'] is True

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_negative
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/9999 with payload {'completed': true}
expected: Error message 'Task with id 9999 not found'
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to mark non-existent task as complete
response = client.put('/tasks/9999', json={'completed': True})

# Expected: Check response
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()['detail'] == 'Task with id 9999 not found'

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_boundary
preconditions: A task exists in the database with id=1
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with payload {'completed': false}
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task
response = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Boundary Task', 'description': 'Boundary Description'})
assert response.status_code == 201
created_task = response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Action: Mark task as not complete
response = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'completed': False})

# Expected: Check response
assert response.status_code == 200
updated_task = response.json()
assert updated_task['completed'] is False
